# Plugins

63 first-party plugins for Unbound. Install them from the [store](https://unbound.rip/plugins).

<!-- Generated from each manifest.json by `bun run plugins:readme`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/image-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Add Attachments](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.add-attachments): Adds attachments to messages you already sent, while you edit them or from the message menu.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/gif-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Always Animate](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.always-animate): Animates anything that can be animated: avatars, decorations, nameplates, profile effects, server icons, emojis, stickers and GIFs.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/link-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Always Trust](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.always-trust): Opens links and downloads without asking whether you trust the site or the file first.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/file-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Anonymise File Names](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.anonymise-filenames): Replaces the names of files you upload with random characters, a fixed name or a timestamp, keeping the extension.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/globe-earth-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Aussie Mode](https://unbound.rip/addons/adrian.aussie-mode): Discord designed for Aussies.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/microphone-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Aussie Speech](https://unbound.rip/addons/adrian.aussie-speech): Turns every message into Aussie English before you send it.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/user-square-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Avatar Radius](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.avatar-radius): Rounds avatars to a corner radius you choose instead of circles.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/eye-slash-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Blur NSFW](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.blur-nsfw): Blurs attachments and embedded media in age-restricted channels until you tap them.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/keyboard-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Channel Typing Indicators](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.channel-typing-indicators): Shows animated typing dots and avatars beside channels where people are typing.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/text-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Character Counter](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.character-counter): Shows the current message length and Discord's character limit in the composer.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/paint-palette-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Chat Bubbles](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.chat-bubbles): Draws a rounded bubble behind each message.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/link-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Clear URLs](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.clear-urls): Removes tracking garbage from URLs before you send them.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/keyboard-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Custom Commands](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.custom-commands): Create slash commands that send saved text, images, and videos.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/image-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Dearrow](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.dearrow): Makes YouTube embed titles and thumbnails less sensationalist, powered by DeArrow.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/reaction-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Expression Tools](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.expression-tools): Useful tools for custom emojis and stickers.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/image-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [File Size On Picker](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.file-size-on-picker): Shows file sizes on media picker thumbnails.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/gif-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Fix GIF Downloads](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.fix-gif-download): Save Discord GIFs as GIF files instead of videos.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/image-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Fix Youtube Embeds](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.fix-youtube-embeds): Plays YouTube videos that are blocked from playing in Discord, such as music videos from UMG, instead of showing an error.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/crown-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Force Owner Crown](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.force-owner-crown): Always show the owner crown on the server owner's messages.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/gif-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [GIF Paste](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.gif-paste): Makes GIF picker selections paste a link into the chat box instead of sending immediately.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/gif-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [GIF Provider Switcher](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.gif-provider-switcher): Search GIFs from Tenor or Giphy instead of Klipy, and switch providers right from the GIF picker.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/gift-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Hide Gift Button](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.hide-gift-button): Hide the gift button from the chat composer.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/eye-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [I Love Spam](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.i-love-spam): Shows messages from users Discord marks as likely spammers instead of hiding them.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/user-circle-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Mention Avatars](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.mention-avatars): Shows user avatars and role icons inside mentions.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/timer-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Message Latency](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.message-latency): Marks messages that took at least the selected threshold to send.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/link-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Message Link Embeds](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.message-link-embeds): Adds previews to messages that link to other Discord messages.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/eye-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Message Logger](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.message-logger): Keeps deleted and edited messages in the chat.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/user-plus-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [More User Tags](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.more-user-tags): Adds tags for webhooks and moderative roles.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/microphone-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Moyai](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.moyai): Plays a thud when Moyai appears in the current channel or as a reaction.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/user-circle-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Multi Account](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.multi-account): Unlocks Discord's built-in multi-account switcher on mobile.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/music-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Music Rich Presence](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.music-rich-presence): Shows what you are scrobbling on Last.fm or ListenBrainz as your Discord activity.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/bell-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [New Guild Settings](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.new-guild-settings): Mutes new servers and applies your notification and channel defaults as soon as you join them.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/eye-slash-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [No Blocked Messages](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.no-blocked-messages): Hides messages from blocked users completely.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/bell-slash-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [No Pending Count](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.no-pending-count): Hides the red counts for incoming friend requests and message requests.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/ic-swipe-reply-24px.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [No Reply Mention](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.no-reply-mention): Disable reply mentions by default.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/chat-dots-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [No Typing Animation](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.no-typing-animation): Stops the typing dots from animating, so they sit still wherever someone is typing.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/bell-z-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [One Ping Per DM](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.one-ping-per-dm): Plays the in-app message sound only for the first unread message in a DM, until you read it.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/forum-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Override Forum Defaults](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.override-forum-defaults): Sets your own default layout and sort order for forum channels. You can still change them per channel.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/shield-user-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Permissions Viewer](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.permissions-viewer): View the permissions a member or channel has, and the roles of a server.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/video-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Picture In Picture](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.picture-in-picture): Adds a picture in picture button to videos and video embeds such as YouTube in the media viewer, so they keep playing in a floating window.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/laptop-phone-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Platform Indicators](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.platform-indicators): Shows which platforms users are online on, such as desktop, mobile, web, console or VR, in the member list, profiles and messages.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/eye-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Preview Message](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.preview-message): Preview a message before sending it.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/user-square-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [PronounDB](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.pronoundb): Adds pronouns to user messages using PronounDB.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/reaction-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Reaction Avatars](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.reaction-avatars): Shows the people who reacted beside each message reaction.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/user-minus-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Relationship Notifier](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.relationship-notifier): Notifies you when a friend, group chat, or server removes you.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/star-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [ReviewDB](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.reviewdb): Leave reviews on other users' profiles and see what others think of you.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/paint-palette-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Role Color Everywhere](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.role-color-everywhere): Colors mentions, typing names, voice users, reaction users, poll voters, and role headers.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/settings-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Settings Demo](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.settings-demo): Shows every generated settings row.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/text-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Shiki Codeblocks](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.shiki-codeblocks): Highlights code blocks with VS Code-style syntax colors.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/eye-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Show Hidden Things](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.show-hidden-things): Displays hidden and moderator-only features regardless of permissions.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/text-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Show Me Your Name](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.show-me-your-name): Display usernames next to display names, or show usernames only.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/timer-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Show Timeout Duration](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.show-timeout-duration): Shows how much longer a user's timeout will last.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/bell-slash-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Silent Message Toggle](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.silent-message-toggle): Adds a button to the chat input that sends your next messages as silent messages.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/headphones-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Spotify Listen Along](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.spotify-listen-along): Listen along to someone's Spotify activity and invite a channel to listen along with you.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/sticker-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Sticker Preview](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.sticker-preview): Displays a preview of a selected sticker instead of sending it immediately.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/super-reaction-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Super Reaction Tweaks](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.super-reaction-tweaks): Opens the reaction picker on Super Reactions and caps how many Super Reaction animations play at once.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/text-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Text Replace](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.text-replace): Replace text in messages before you send them.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/language-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Translate](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.translate): Translate messages.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/keyboard-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Typing Avatars](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.typing-avatars): Shows the avatars of people typing in the channel.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/embed-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Unsuppress Embeds](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.unsuppress-embeds): Adds a message long-press row that brings back suppressed link embeds, or suppresses them.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/image-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [View Icons](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.view-icons): View user avatars, banners, server icons, server banners, and group DM icons.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/chevron-large-right-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [View Raw](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.view-raw): View and copy raw data for messages, channels, guilds, and user profiles.
- <img src="../../assets/plugins/readme-icons/eye-slash-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Youtube Adblock](https://unbound.rip/addons/unbound.youtube-adblock): Blocks ads in YouTube videos played inside Discord and in the Watch Together activity, using AdGuard's YouTube ad blocker.
